description: This Java test class `DefaultMetricsConfigTest` performs unit testing for the `DefaultMetricsConfig` class within the metrics configuration package. It verifies immutability, equality/hash code consistency, and correct default and configured value retrieval for metrics configuration settings.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for `DefaultMetricsConfig`, testing immutability, equality, and configuration retrieval behavior.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test configuration by loading the 'metrics-test' configuration file.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of `equals` and `hashCode` implementations for `DefaultMetricsConfig`.

methods.name: gettersReturnDefaultValuesIfNotConfigured
methods.description: Checks that default values are returned when configuration is empty.

methods.name: gettersReturnConfiguredValues
methods.description: Checks that configured values are correctly retrieved from the provided config.
